notes.title: Steam Summer Contests
notes.content:
Dear friends! There are only a few days left before the sale ends, so don’t miss your chance to buy games from your wishlist with great discounts and save money on something extra ;)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33134735/a885c5941462dbd50147c996f9dcc8a810867f18.png

Also, don’t forget that you still have an opportunity to get some free stuff as well. All you have to do is to participate in our mad contests:


 Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest — if space exploration is your thing, then you will feel right at home in this humorous adventure game.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/645820/announcements/detail/1599256909899934929

 Tempest — roving the seas and looking for lost treasures is what you gonna do most of the time in the pirate themed RPG.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/418180/announcements/detail/1616145408491267654
 
 INSOMNIA: The Ark — 400 years of space travel can drive anyone crazy, but hey, the dark corridors of this Fallout inspired RPG hide an entrance to a beach (well, an imaginary one).
https://steamcommunity.com/games/783170/announcements/detail/1607138209235663089



Thank you for your attention, and have a nice weekend!

notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33134735/a885c5941462dbd50147c996f9dcc8a810867f18.png

Dear friends! The weekend is ahead, and we all know what this means… non-stop gaming thanks to the Steam Summer Sale =)

You do remember we have promised something special earlier, right? So come closer and listen carefully! We have three contests running for three different titles, and you can take part in any/all of them! 

These contests will require some creativity and wit to win cool prizes. However, a good dose of humor will also do the trick =D

In order to participate, follow the links to the game pages below: 

 Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest — if space exploration is your thing, then you will feel right at home in this humorous adventure game.
